# An outside oracle judges the core promise

**Rule:** Check the product's core promise with at least one oracle the author did not write, on every PR or nightly with an issue on failure. Evidence row: ["9 needs" bar per dimension (each dimension)](../../EVIDENCE.md)

**Why:** Tests whose expected outputs come from the code under test can only confirm that the code agrees with itself.

**Incident:** A suite was rigorous, but every expected output was generated by the code under test.

**Enforced by:** [J: Outside judge](../STANDARD.md#j-outside-judge); `tests/test_box_audit.py::test_oracles_proof_rules_and_production`

**Evidence:** observed

**Status:** enforced
